name: isaaccorley-skills
description: Research-workflow skills for Claude Code, focused on writing and reviewing academic papers.

plugins.name: bib-audit
plugins.description: Flag hallucinated references, authors and bib items in any paper — your own draft before submitting, or one you are reviewing — and correct badly formatted ones. Resolves every reference against Crossref, arXiv, DataCite and Semantic Scholar, then ranks findings so integrity problems sort above formatting nits.
